description: スーパーマーケットで、女性がレジで商品を購入しており、近くでは男の子が果物売り場でリンゴを選んでいる場面。

stage1.passage: Many people visit supermarkets to buy food and daily necessities. Supermarkets usually offer fresh fruit, vegetables, drinks, and other products in one place. Shoppers can compare items and prices before paying at the checkout counter.

q1.text: What can shoppers do before paying at the checkout counter?
modelAnswers: They can compare items and prices before paying.
Shoppers can compare different items and their prices before they pay.

questions.text: How often do you go to a supermarket, and what do you usually buy there?
modelAnswers: I go to a supermarket about once a week. I usually buy fruit, drinks, and snacks.
My family goes shopping several times a week, and we usually buy food and vegetables.
I sometimes go to the supermarket after school to buy drinks or snacks.

questions.text: Do you think people should use reusable shopping bags? Why or why not?
modelAnswers: Yes, I think people should use reusable bags because they can reduce plastic waste.
Yes. Reusable bags are better for the environment than using new plastic bags every time.
I think reusable shopping bags are important because we can use them many times.
